# E0346: a lens produces nothing for a field its target version requires

A lens produces every field its target requires. Here the new version adds a
required field the source lacks, and no lens says where it comes from.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0346]: history/1.0.thema has no ForwardLens, and 1.0 requires b: write ForwardLens: {v0_0: _, v1_0: {b: <mapping>}}
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
```
